parts.html: K-10 is a loft-style L-shaped kitchen in brown, with wood-effect lower fronts and glass upper fronts.
Glass above, wood below: the top of the kitchen does not look heavy, and the bottom gives it a warm color. The lower fronts are laminated chipboard with a wood decor.
The cooking zone, built-in appliances, and cabinets run along two adjacent walls. At 5.2 linear meters, there is enough room for everyday tasks even without an island.
The countertop is compact laminate: the material is dense and water-resistant, and the countertop itself stays thin.
Small items and food can be kept in the cargo pull-out.
Hinges: Muller Profi Line with soft-close mechanisms
Drawer runners: Concealed Muller Profi Line
We redraw the K-10 for your kitchen, with its dimensions, utility connections, and appliances. We plan the cabinet interiors together, based on what you keep and where you are used to keeping it.
